import mujoco
import numpy as np

model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('fixed_scene.xml')
data = mujoco.MjData(model)
mujoco.mj_resetDataKeyframe(model, data, 0)
mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)

# Check gripper direction - joint7 axis in world frame
# joint7 is in link7 body, axis=[0,0,-1] in local frame
# Let's check the body xmat for link7
link7_id = mujoco.mj_name2id(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, 'link7')
link8_id = mujoco.mj_name2id(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, 'link8')
print(f"link7 xmat:\n{data.xmat[link7_id].reshape(3,3)}")
print(f"link8 xmat:\n{data.xmat[link8_id].reshape(3,3)}")

# joint7 axis in world = xmat @ [0,0,-1]
j7_axis_world = data.xmat[link7_id].reshape(3,3) @ np.array([0,0,-1])
j8_axis_world = data.xmat[link8_id].reshape(3,3) @ np.array([0,0,1])
print(f"\njoint7 axis in world: {j7_axis_world}")
print(f"joint8 axis in world: {j8_axis_world}")

# Gripper actuator index
gripper_act_id = mujoco.mj_name2id(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_ACTUATOR, 'gripper')
print(f"\nGripper actuator id: {gripper_act_id}")
print(f"Gripper ctrl range: {model.actuator_ctrlrange[gripper_act_id]}")

# Check equality constraint
print(f"\nEquality constraints: {model.neq}")
for i in range(model.neq):
    print(f"  eq[{i}]: type={model.eq_type[i]}, obj1={model.eq_obj1id[i]}, obj2={model.eq_obj2id[i]}, data={model.eq_data[i]}")

# Check contact geoms for gripper fingers
print("\nFinger geom bodies:")
for gname in ['geom_84', 'geom_85', 'geom_87', 'geom_88']:
    gid = mujoco.mj_name2id(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_GEOM, gname)
    bid = model.geom_bodyid[gid]
    bname = mujoco.mj_id2name(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, bid)
    print(f"  {gname} -> body {bname}")

# Check contact target body
ct_id = mujoco.mj_name2id(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, 'fixed_contact_target')
print(f"\nfixed_contact_target body id: {ct_id}, mocap: {model.body_mocapid[ct_id]}")
